Murkowski's "agonizing" vote secured $50B for rural clinics and SNAP flexibility, but the real issue is systemic: 34% of Medicaid spending gets lost in administrative bloat instead of frontline care.

If Congress actually audited the $734B Medicaid budget instead of playing appropriation shell games, families wouldn’t face impossible choices. The bill’s 5-year sunset clauses and GAO reviews? Window dressing.

Real reform requires torching the 42 CFR 435.919 bureaucracy that diverts funds to paperwork over patients.
